name: Nod
description: Runs errands on real websites and in Gmail, Calendar and Slack as n8n's open-source personal agent, with its own sandboxed computer and browser.

skills.name: Call Briefs
skills.description: Writes a one-page brief for each call every morning from your email threads, calendar and the client's latest news.

skills.name: Drafts With Approval
skills.description: Drafts the replies you owe from your own documents and sends them only after you approve each one.

skills.name: Web Errands
skills.description: Completes web errands such as chasing invoices or cancelling trials in its own sandboxed browser and Linux workspace.

skills.name: Scheduled Page Checks
skills.description: Checks web pages on a schedule, such as a client's pricing page, and reports only when something changes.

skills.name: Visible Memory
skills.description: Remembers facts and preferences from your own messages, with every note visible, editable and forgettable.
